title: Final velocity after collision
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly calculate the velocity of the plank-block system after the elastic collision with the barrier using momentum conservation.

title: Relative displacement calculation
description: Important Criteria: Student must apply the work-energy theorem correctly to find the relative displacement between block and plank after collision.

title: Minimum length derivation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must determine the minimum plank length to prevent the block from falling off when M < m using energy considerations.

title: Momentum conservation setup
description: Important Criteria: Student must properly set up the momentum conservation equation accounting for direction changes after the elastic collision.

title: Friction work calculation
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly calculate work done by friction in both the relative displacement and minimum length scenarios.

title: Sign error in momentum
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly assigns signs to velocities after the elastic collision with the barrier.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Student maintains consistent units throughout calculations and final answers.

title: Condition recognition
description: Important Criteria: Student recognizes and applies different conditions for M > m and M < m scenarios appropriately.
